## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a)

## 维护者速读

- 这是你同意的「每周一张 ADR 修订合集卡」的第一个 PR：五份 ADR 里写的和现在代码不一致的地方，各加一段注明日期的补注。原文一个字没改，只在原处后面写「现在实际是什么、哪个 PR 改的、依据哪条裁决」。
- 五处分别是：
  - ADR-0090/0151：审计的「代谁操作」现在除了外部客户端，还多了产品内 AI 这一种来源。
  - ADR-0113：必填字段的显示条件引用公式时，只在表单算不出该公式时才提醒。
  - ADR-0149：数据集的每个入口都只接受数据集声明过的指标和维度。
  - ADR-0126：「能力」现在可以在环境里新建（打包的仍锁定），四处表述都补了注。
  - ADR-0090：平台基线权限的贡献通道只给常驻平台服务用，租户安装的包不用。
- 我逐条核对了补注里引用的代码文件、函数和设置，在当前主干上都对得上。
- 要你做什么：`docs/adr/**` 需要你亲手批准一次（Tier H）。

**Head reviewed:** `46b1cf5802a10d02ed588117b90f5bf47be992cf` on main `7de1bad5`.

- Two commits, 5 files under `docs/adr/`, **+96/−0**. There are no `-` lines in the diff: every change is an append-only dated note, and no original decision text is rewritten.
- `git merge-tree` onto current main is clean.

### Rows of card #35731 → notes

| Card row | Note(s) at this head |
|---|---|
| ADR-0090 D10 rule 4 + 2026-09-20 note; ADR-0151 "Leaves unchanged" (`performedBy` second producer) | ADR-0090 note under D10; ADR-0151 note under the bullet |
| ADR-0113 "Author-time fence" (formula warning narrowed) | ADR-0113 note |
| ADR-0149 "Leaves unchanged" (`/analytics/dataset/query`) | ADR-0149 note |
| ADR-0126, four code-only places (`capability`) | four notes: §1.1 table, the list bullet, the **outside** row, the reopened item |
| ADR-0090 D9 (platform baseline channel = always-on platform services only) | ADR-0090 note in D9's neighbourhood |

All five rows are covered. The rows added to the card later are carried to next week's card, as the PR body's Follow-ups say (the seat's call). The card's ADR-0113 rider ("fix any `skills/**` quote of the old sentence") finds nothing to fix: `git grep` over `skills/**` at this head turns up no quote of the old warn-on-every-formula sentence.

### Each cited fact, checked in the tree at this head

- **ADR-0090 D9.**
  - `ISecurityService.contributePlatformBaselineSet` is in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`.
  - `plugin-security/src/platform-baseline-sets.ts` documents the boot-only window (closes at `kernel:bootstrapped`) and read-and-create-only, and refuses other bits.
  - Its one non-test caller is `service-storage/src/attachment-member-grant.ts`.
- **ADR-0090 D10 / ADR-0151.**
  - `execution-context.zod.ts#performedBy` names `clientId` and `agentId`, with `conversationId` and `confirmationId`. It is refused at parse unless one of the two is set, and an id is stamped only once the server has resolved it for the person in `userId`.
  - `assemble-execution-context.ts#entryFields` exists.
  - `engine-execution-plumbing.ts` copies the three keys to `HookContext.provenance.performedBy*`.
  - "No code in this repository stamps `agentId` today" holds. `plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` reads `performedByAgentId`, and no non-test code builds a `performedBy` with it.
  - The tightened ADR-0151 sentence (D5's reason 2 predates the ruling that puts both kinds of id in `performed_by`) is narrower than the first draft's "D5's reasons all hold", and correct.
- **ADR-0113.** `packages/lint/src/required-visible-when-formula-issue.ts` and `app-shell/…/inspectors/requiredVisibleWhenReference.ts` exist, and `planObjectFormulas` is the classifier both cite. PR #35475 is `7702f091` on main.
- **ADR-0126.**
  - The `capability` registry row in `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` reads `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`, `supportsOverlay: false`.
  - `field`, `job`, `api` and `agent` all read `allowRuntimeCreate: false`, so "the code-only set is now field, job, api, agent" holds.
  - `CapabilityDeclarationSchema` is the `capability` entry in `metadata-type-schemas.ts`, the corrected source in `46b1cf58`.
  - `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` refuses a curated platform capability name before writing.
  - `package-namespace-rename.ts` handles `capability` rows.
  - PR #35261 is `6ffa816e` on main.
- **ADR-0149.** `undeclaredSelectionMembers` is in `service-analytics/src/dataset-declared-members.ts` and is asked in `analytics-service.ts` beside `answerDataset`, with `400 INVALID_FIELD`. `dataset-tools.ts` and `metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` exist.
- **Ruling and record ids** (6837170004, 6999763503, 7000639892, 6902027136, cloud#3826) are the ones the card rows quote.
- **Not checkable from here.** This checkout is shallow, so the merge SHAs of #34018 (`2539ad98`), #34198 (`898655a9`) and #32932 (`fd637471`) cannot be confirmed. The code each note describes is on the tree, as above.

### Gates

- `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` at this head: **OK**. 126 anchored files, every governing ADR still referenced, 76280 citations resolve. The card's "re-anchor any `scripts/adr-anchors/**` entry the edit moves" needs nothing.
- `check-governed-merges --pr 35976`, run from a worktree at this head: **GOVERNED, Tier H** (`docs/adr/**` ×5). The low-risk arm does not apply: ADR-0090 is a permissions record, as the PR body says.
- The dev reports `dispatch-gates --commands` 21/21 exit 0 and a clean overlap check. Not re-run here.

### Disclosure

The ADR-0090 D9 note describes the seam's admission bounds (boot window, read and create bits, own objects, one set per contributor). That restates the public contract docblocks on `main`, and carries no exploit or weakness detail.

### Findings

None.

### Landing terms

- Tier H: an APPROVED review from os-zhuang on this head, a green head, then the seat lands it. No L2 is named for a dated-note ADR PR on this card.
- A new push needs a delta L1 unless it is a clean main merge.
- This review does not approve, mark ready, enqueue or request review.

  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.

     Grade each finding must-fix, should-fix or nit — a nit has no effect on correctness or the contract.

     Spell a must-fix or should-fix with its id and grade, `S1 (should-fix) — …`, and a clean round as
     `No must-fix, no should-fix.`: the queue guard reads a graded finding as OPEN on this head and
     refuses the record; the delta record names those it closes by id alone, `S1: closed`.
     A nit is fixed only on the prose faces, or left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card: a fix
     anywhere else moves the head, and this record no longer covers it.
     ⛔ Judge the tree, never the PR body's account of it.

thing after each colon.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `46b1cf5802a10d02ed588117b90f5bf47be992cf`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md, docs/adr/0113-required-write-contract-vs-column-constraint.md, docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md, docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md, docs/adr/0151-ai-service-account-a-headless-agent-is-a-registered-principal-of-its-own.md + none
Security-touching: yes

Read: card #35731 (body and all seven comments), PR #35976 (body, file list, net diff against `main`, merge base `7de1bad5c`), the check-runs on the head, the four ruling comments the notes cite (6837170004, 6902027136, 6999763503, 7000639892), and the cited code on `origin/main` `9a8bb83d4`. Nothing was built or run. No file in the diff implements the notes; the diff is the five ADR files alone, so `+ none`.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant: the ADR-0090 notes teach the member-baseline grant channel and write attribution, the ADR-0151 note teaches what `performed_by` holds, and the ADR-0126 notes teach who may declare a capability. The low-risk arm does not apply; the adopting seat adds the `security` label.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Add-only: right.** The net diff is 5 files, +96 / -0, with no removed line. Every hunk is a dated blockquote note placed after the passage it corrects; no decision text, table row or Status line is rewritten.
- **Public surface: none.** No package, schema, generated file, skill or anchor file is in the diff. The card's two riders hold on the tree: no `skills/**` file quotes the old ADR-0113 warn-on-every-formula sentence, and no `scripts/adr-anchors/**` entry is in the diff (the `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Check Documentation Links` check-runs are green on this head).
- **Row coverage: right.** All five body rows of the card have a note (ADR-0126 carries four, one per stale passage). The three rows appended as comments after the build (ADR-0158, ADR-0093, ADR-0154) are not in the diff; the claim amendment of 2026-11-21T00:08Z scopes them out and the PR body lists them as follow-ups. That is a scope call the card thread declared, not a defect of this head; they must be carried to next week's card because this PR closes #35731.
- **Prerequisites: right.** PR #32932 (`fd637471`), #34018 (`2539ad98`), #34198 (`898655a9`), #35261 (`6ffa816e`) and #35475 (`7702f091`) are all merged, and each cited short SHA resolves to that PR's merge commit on `main`.
- **Gate verdicts.** Every check-run on the head concluded `success` or `skipped`, none failed; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` are green.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: the diff is Markdown under `docs/adr/**` and publishes nothing. `Check Changeset` concluded `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **SQL push-down:** not applicable; the diff holds no code, no query and no id materialisation.
- **Dev flag, "no code in this repository stamps `agentId` yet":** answered, holds. On `main` the only construction of `performedBy` outside tests is `{ clientId }` (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts#entryFields`, and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-actor-attribution.ts` for a forwarded agent's identity write); the audit writers and the engine plumbing only read `agentId`.
- **Dev flag, the two hand-over corrections (ADR-0151 "D5's reason 2 predates it"; ADR-0126 section 1.1 naming `metadata-type-schemas.ts` for the body check):** answered, both hold against the tree.
- **Dev flag, the two stale passages left untouched (ADR-0090 Status line's 2026-11-08 bullet; ADR-0151 D5 body text):** answered. They are outside the card's rows and recorded on the card (comment 7033059191). The ADR-0151 note already tells a reader that D5's reason 2 predates the ruling, so the D5 half is covered in substance on this head.
- **Escalated to the maintainer, not a finding on this head:** the ADR-0126 section 3 note says the ruling assigned `capability` no regime and assigns none. That is accurate, and it leaves `capability` as a runtime-creatable type that is neither in a regime nor, any longer, in the "outside" row as code-only, while section 2 requires a type to name its regime at admission. Its posture today equals the "unassigned, deliberately" row (locked base, free sibling authoring). Whether to record it there is the maintainer's call; a note may not rule it.

### ④ Design judgment

Each note was read against the code it cites on `main`, sentence by sentence.

**docs/adr/0090 (D9 note, platform baseline channel).** Holds. `ISecurityService.contributePlatformBaselineSet(contributor, set)` is in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`; `platform-baseline-sets.ts` admits during boot only (the window closes at `kernel:bootstrapped`), only objects the contributor owns in the registry, only `allowRead` and `allowCreate`, one set per contributor, and refuses `'*'`, every other bit and `rowLevelSecurity`; the calling seam logs the admission at info and the refusal at warn. The one non-test contributor is `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-member-grant.ts`. The bolded sentence is condition 2 of ruling 6837170004 verbatim, and that ruling names this ADR sentence as "a separate Tier H PR", which this is.

**docs/adr/0090 (D10 note) and docs/adr/0151.** Hold. `execution-context.zod.ts#performedBy` carries `clientId`, `agentId`, `conversationId`, `confirmationId`, refuses a present object naming neither performer (`requiredOneOf`), and its docblock states the resolve-before-stamp duty and that the run-id room stays reserved. `engine-execution-plumbing.ts` copies the three keys to `HookContext.provenance`. `plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts#auditPerformerMetadata` records `clientId ?? agentId` as `performed_by`, which is what the ADR-0151 note says of D5's reason 2. ADR-0011's 2026-11-15 amendment note does record the cloud#3826 ruling. The envelope-level "no `onBehalfOf`" is right (the audit row still writes `on_behalf_of` from `user_id`, which the notes do not contradict).

**docs/adr/0113.** Holds. `packages/lint/src/required-visible-when-formula-issue.ts` returns nothing when every formula the predicate reads is one the form computes, warns on the write-path arm (a hop through a reference, `label()`, `current_user.can()`, or such a formula at any depth) and on the form-only arm (`os`), and draws nothing for a formula that reads the acting user or is served without its expression; `requiredVisibleWhenReference.ts` states the same verdict; `planObjectFormulas` is in `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/formulaRecord.ts`.

**docs/adr/0149.** Holds. `undeclaredSelectionMembers` is asked in `answerDataset` through `assertSelectionMembersDeclared`, after `compile` and before the draft-preview branch and any read, so every caller of `IAnalyticsService.queryDataset` meets it; `dataset-tools.ts` asks it again; the refusal is 400 `INVALID_FIELD`; a dataset-qualified spelling is refused; an inline dataset is judged against its own declaration. Ruling 6902027136 says exactly 「REST 也拒绝(收紧)」.

**docs/adr/0126 (four notes).** The `capability` registry row reads `supportsOverlay: false, allowEnvironmentOverlay: false, allowRuntimeCreate: true`; `capability: CapabilityDeclarationSchema` is the type's schema entry; `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` refuses a `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_NAMES` name and a name another holder declares before anything is written; `package-namespace-rename.ts` renames a copied capability and its grants and requirements. Rulings 6999763503 (option A, 「同意」) and 7000639892 (「接受现有边界」) say what the notes say. One sentence does not hold:

S1 (should-fix) — docs/adr/0126, the section 1.1 note, "The code-only set is now field, job, api, agent." This is a claim about the live registry, and the registry the same note cites disagrees. On `main`, `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` holds eight types with `supportsOverlay: false`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay: false` and `allowRuntimeCreate: false`, the table's own definition of tier C ("no runtime write channel exists"): `field`, `picklist`, `job`, `api`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`, `agent`. Four of them were admitted after the survey the table records. A note whose job is to bring the passage in step with `main` writes a new sentence that is out of step the day it lands, and a seat that reads "the code-only set is now" as complete is told `picklist` or `sharing_rule` is not in it. Fix on the prose face: say the claim the note can support, for example "Of the five types this table lists as code-only, four remain so: field, job, api, agent. The registry has since gained other types with no runtime write channel, which this table predates." The section 9 note's "the other four code-only types stay as this item says" is relative to the item's own list and holds as written.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 — docs/adr/0090 D10 note and docs/adr/0151 note: "the `/mcp` door is still the one producer here". A forwarded agent's `clientId` is also stamped at the door that redeems a rule 5 forward credential, and by `auth-actor-attribution.ts#authSystemWriteContext` for a forwarded identity write. Both carry the provenance the `/mcp` door verified, rule 4's own text names the forward door, and `main`'s `clientId` docblock says "Set by the `/mcp` OAuth door only", so the note matches the shipped contract wording. "The OAuth agent path" would be the exact phrase.
- N2 — docs/adr/0090 D9 note: "joins the member baseline every signed-in member holds" omits two bounds the seam's docblock states: a deployment that declares no member baseline (`fallbackPermissionSet: null`) hands the set to no one, and a host can narrow or decline a contributed object through `SecurityPluginOptions.platformBaselineOverrides`. Neither widens anything.
- N3 — docs/adr/0113 note: for the write-path arm it says the field "stays required on every write"; for a `current_user.can()` formula the engine does compute it on a write that picks a permission-gated option, which the lint message itself says.
- N4 — header index: ADR-0090, ADR-0113 and ADR-0151 each list their amendments on a `**Amended** (date, ref)` line under the Status line (ADR-0151's two earlier notes each added one). These notes add none, so the header no longer indexes every dated note. An add-only pointer line per ADR would restore that; the notes are findable in place either way.

No must-fix. S1 is open on this head and earns a delta review of its fix.

**VERDICT: PASS**
